snippet.title: DIEATHLON Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Here is the reveal trailer for DIEATHLON, a fast-paced downhill shooter developed by Long Void Games. Race down treacherous, frostbitten mountain slopes with only your weapons and reflexes keeping you alive. Blast through obstacles, fight relentless monsters, uncover hidden routes, and make split-second decisions as every path presents new hazards and deadly challenges. Conquer the mountain in DIEATHLON on PC via Steam.

Wishlist DIEATHLON here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4212790/DIEATHLON/
